name: 陳雅玫
objective: This course is designed to equip students with the necessary English communication skills in the workplace. The content will include English resume writing, business English, English interviews, briefing skills, and office English conversation. This course will also strengthen students’ basic English skills, such as vocabulary, grammar, and writing.

1. continuous assessment (including attendance, participation, in-class exercises and quizzes): 40%
2. mid-term and final exams: 30%
3. English Proficiency Test: 20%
4.Job Interview Self-Introduction Video: 10%
materials:
Work English 1

本課程為專業英文（ESP / EAP）課程，教材、講義及簡報均為全英文；課堂授課及師生互動之英語使用比例 70%(含) 以上。
延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）
remarks:
Weeks 17-18: Flexible Learning

Students will be asked to create a professional self-introduction video tailored for a job interview and submit it by the end of Week 18. The video will showcase their presentation skills, language delivery, and ability to effectively communicate their qualifications.

The video will account for 10% of the final grade.
